queries_run: HDD industry inventory destocking OR restocking 2026 Seagate
HDD spot price OR contract price trend 2026 nearline

findings.claim: Trefis 引述 Seagate 管理層：nearline 產能『almost fully allocated through calendar 2027』（已被預訂到 2027 年底）。
findings.source: Trefis, 'Seagate Is Sold Out Through 2027 As AI Reshapes Hard Drive Demand', https://www.trefis.com/stock/stx/articles/597921/seagate-is-sold-out-through-2027-as-ai-reshapes-hard-drive-demand/2026-04-30

findings.claim: 同篇 Trefis 文章寫：Seagate 現在是『setting terms with customers rather than reacting to market fluctuations』，走多年期 build-to-order 合約；並稱傳統的庫存過剩風險『no longer a near-term concern』（此為 Trefis 的描述，非公司財報數字）。
findings.source: Trefis, 'Seagate Is Sold Out Through 2027 As AI Reshapes Hard Drive Demand', https://www.trefis.com/stock/stx/articles/597921/seagate-is-sold-out-through-2027-as-ai-reshapes-hard-drive-demand/2026-04-30

findings.claim: 同篇 Trefis 文章引述：非 GAAP 毛利率 Q3 達『all-time high of 47.0%』，去年同期為 36.2%。
findings.source: Trefis, 'Seagate Is Sold Out Through 2027 As AI Reshapes Hard Drive Demand', https://www.trefis.com/stock/stx/articles/597921/seagate-is-sold-out-through-2027-as-ai-reshapes-hard-drive-demand/2026-04-30

cyclical_inventory_price_position.note: 本軸只有 Trefis 一篇二手來源能核實發布日；價格方向只有間接證據（毛利率、『setting terms』），沒找到有日期的 nearline 現貨／合約價格序列。搜尋摘要另有聚合站稱『HDD 價格 2025-09 至 2026-01 平均漲約 46%』『nearline 約季增 4%』『DIO 86 天，比五年均值長約 10 天』，但摘要未標明確切來源頁與發布日，依規則不列為 finding。渠道庫存（channel inventory）無公司或分銷商的直接揭露。Seagate 2026-09-09 的 8-K 附件（SEC）只講可交換票據贖回／交換，不含庫存或價格資料。
